question: centre wise attendance percentage for 2023 and 2024 side by side
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre ORDER BY centre
sql_duckdb: WITH attendance_2023 AS (SELECT Centre, Month, Enrolled_Kids, Avg_Daily_Present FROM attendance_2023), attendance_2024 AS (SELECT centre_name, month, enrolment, average_attendance FROM attendance_2024) SELECT a23.Centre, a23.Month, a23.Enrolled_Kids, a23.Avg_Daily_Present, a24.enrolment, a24.average_attendance, (a24.enrolment * 100.0 / NULLIF(a23.Enrolled_Kids, 0)) AS attendance_percentage_2024 FROM attendance_2023 AS a23 JOIN attendance_2024 AS a24 ON a23.Centre = a24.centre_name AND a23.Month = a24.month
